title: Routine use of positron-emission tomography/computed tomography for staging of primary colorectal cancer: does it affect clinical management?
abstract: The use of positron emission tomography-computed tomography (PET/CT) for the preoperative staging of patients with colon and rectal cancer has increased steadily over the last decade. The aim of this study was to evaluate the effect of PET/CT on the preoperative staging and clinical management of patients with colorectal cancer.
